metric_definitions.source_hit_at_k: Whether at least one of the top-k retrieved passages has the same source_record_id as the benchmark gold source.
metric_definitions.mrr_at_10: Mean reciprocal rank of the first correct-source passage within the top 10; zero if no correct-source passage occurs.
metric_definitions.gold_context_recall_at_k: Number of benchmark-attached gold context passages appearing in the top k divided by the number of attached gold context passages.
